scope: Metadata only; no images, training, new downloads, root scripts or brain modifications

alignment.keys: preserve input order; exact scene folder + center_x/y + MMSI; OSS1 XML ordinal checked

ais.sog: integer raw 0..1022 divided by 10 knots; 1023 missing; 1022 is >=102.2 knots, excluded from point-vector projections
ais.cog: integer raw 0..3599 divided by 10 degrees clockwise from true north; 3600 missing; low-speed direction not necessarily meaningful
ais.true_heading: 0..359 degrees, 511 missing; independent from COG and SAR Chip_Direction
ais.nav_status: raw code retained; 15 undefined; 0..14 encoded categories include reserved statuses, not a validated activity label
ais.draught: raw 1..254 /10 metres; 0 missing; 255 lower bound >=25.5m; outside 0..255 invalid; update time unknown
ais.dimensions: AIS Length/Width metres, MarineTraffic Length_overall/Breadth_extreme metres and SAR Manual_Length metres remain separate; no fallback
ais.timegap: AIS UTC epoch - Ship.xml SAR UTC; signed seconds; no timegap excluded automatically; 60/120/300s flags are sensitivity views
ais.static_time: AIS dynamic timestamp is not evidence of dimensions/draught update time

geometry.method: Scipy CubicHermiteSpline uses original timed ECEF position metres and velocity m/s, no extrapolation; pyproj WGS84 lon/lat to ECEF at ellipsoid height 0m
geometry.time: evaluate at reported Ship.xml SAR time, constant per product; not recovered per-target azimuth time; geographic ground proxy only
geometry.los: target to satellite unit vector transformed into target local east,north,up; horizontal normalized LOS also retained
geometry.incidence: acos(up component), compared to geometry.csv incidence for OSS1 / raw XML for OSS2; absolute residual <=1deg is a coarse prespecified consistency flag, not accuracy certification
geometry.flight: normalize satellite ECEF velocity projected onto target local horizontal plane; not PASS-derived bearing
geometry.ground: SOG vector: east=speed*sin(COG), north=speed*cos(COG), vertical=0; dot horizontal LOS for ground range-direction proxy; dot 3D LOS for slant-LOS ground-motion contribution; dot flight for alongflight; abs columns discard sign
geometry.positive_signs: LOS toward satellite; range_away opposite horizontal LOS; alongflight in projected satellite flight direction
geometry.validity: point SOG + coded COG + orbit bracket + finite above-horizon geometry + reported SAR timestamp inside product acquisition interval + incidence residual <=1deg; does NOT certify simultaneity or physical motion truth

product.pixel_spacing: range spacing uses srgr_flag=1 ground vs 0 slant; azimuth spacing stored separately; neither is effective resolution
product.processing: raw metadata flags describe native product; imported displayed chips may have separate scaling/cropping; raw attributes/bands retained in product_metadata_raw.json
product.local_duplicate_folder: OSS2 scene ending (1) retained; metadata PRODUCT is checked against exact name minus that observed suffix

xml.method: existing audit lxml structured parser with recover=True and UTF8 replacement; no source files edited; errors and affected fields recorded per product

provenance_only: imported_heading_deg is SAR Chip_Direction, not AIS heading
imported_mixed_length_m may include SAR fallback, never independent truth
